title: Pre-launch security audit — trial, auth, billing, claim
scope: Register / OAuth / Landing / Settings billing redirects

findings.title: Checkout allowed during active no-card live trial
findings.detail: create-subscription-checkout accepted new subscriptions while sites.expires_at was still in the future, bypassing post-trial plan selection UX.
findings.fix: Return 409 LIVE_TRIAL_ACTIVE when hasActiveLiveTrialSite and not additionalSite checkout.

findings.title: Gallery published sites readable cross-tenant
findings.detail: Public gallery sites return 200 to any authenticated user by design; owner APIs (orders/products) return 403. Re-verify after launch.

findings.title: Claim token brute force
findings.detail: 64-hex tokens + sha256 storage + timing-safe hash compare + claimAcceptLimiter. No token enumeration via distinct error bodies on GET.

findings.title: Stripe webhook signature verification
findings.detail: Raw body + constructEvent; 400 on bad signature; 503 when secrets unset.

findings.title: Session cookies
findings.detail: httpOnly + sameSite=lax on access/refresh cookies; secure in production.

findings.title: STRIPE_TRIAL_DAYS before first publish
findings.detail: Users with zero published sites can still start Checkout with STRIPE_TRIAL_DAYS (7) if PLATFORM_COLLECT_PAYMENTS=true, parallel to LIVE_TRIAL_DAYS clock.
findings.fix: Consider blocking checkout until first publish or align STRIPE_TRIAL_DAYS with LIVE_TRIAL_DAYS when billing opens.

findings.title: Manual /settings/billing?plan= deep link
findings.detail: highlightedPlan query still highlights subscribe buttons after trial; no auto-checkout. Low risk.
findings.fix: Optional: strip plan query during active live trial.

findings.title: Residual beta copy in legal HTML footer
findings.detail: Privacy policy footer still references beta period; Terms header softened in this slice.
findings.fix: Sweep remaining legal templates before public launch.

summary.verdict: ship after P0 fix; P2 tracked
